instructions.title: Cook the Mashed Potatoes
instructions.description: Cut potatoes into evenly-sized chunks. Bring a medium pot with potato chunks covered by water to a boil. Once boiling, cook until fork-tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from burner. Reserve 1/4 cup potato cooking water. Drain potatoes in a colander/strainer and return to pot. Add sour cream, 2 Tbsp. reserved potato cooking water, 1/4 tsp. salt, Parmesan, and a pinch of pepper. Mash until combined and smooth. If too thick, add additional reserved potato cooking water, 1 Tbsp. at a time, until desired consistency is reached. Cover and set aside. While potatoes cook, continue recipe.

instructions.title: Stuff the Chicken
instructions.description: In a mixing bowl, mash softened cream cheese and half the pesto (reserve remaining for sauce) until combined and smooth. Pat chicken dry. Place chicken on a separate cutting board. Hold knife blade parallel to the board and carefully make a lengthwise cut through the center of chicken, using your free hand to steady chicken. Stop short of opposite edge so chicken remains in one piece. Open chicken as you would a book. Season both sides with a pinch of salt and pepper. Divide cream cheese-pesto mixture evenly between chicken breasts, placing in center. Fold chicken in half over filling.

instructions.title: Bread the Chicken
instructions.description: Place a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 2 Tbsp. olive oil. Let oil heat, 5 minutes. While oil heats, in another mixing bowl, combine half the cornstarch (remaining is yours to use as you please!) and 3 Tbsp. water. Evenly spread panko on a plate. Evenly spread cornstarch-water mixture on one side of chicken. Place chicken onto panko, cornstarch mixture-side down, pressing gently to adhere. After 5 minutes, test oil temperature by adding a pinch of panko to it. It should sizzle gently. If it browns immediately, turn heat down and let oil cool. If it doesn't brown, increase heat.

instructions.description: Lay chicken away from you, panko-side down first, in hot oil and cook until beginning to brown, 2-4 minutes per side. Remove from burner. Transfer chicken, panko-side up, to one side of prepared baking sheet. Wipe pan clean and reserve. While chicken sears, trim green beans, if necessary. Place green beans on empty side of baking sheet. Toss with 1 tsp. olive oil and a pinch of salt and pepper. Spread into a single layer on their side. Roast in hot oven until green beans are tender and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 12-15 minutes. Carefully remove from oven. While chicken and green beans roast, continue recipe.

instructions.description: Pat steaks dry. Season both sides with garlic pepper and 1/4 tsp. salt. Place a medium non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add 1 tsp. olive oil. Add steaks to hot pan. Cook undisturbed until browned, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from burner. After 15 minutes, carefully remove tray from oven. Stir in pesto until combined and push vegetables to one side. instructions.description: Carefully massage rice in bag to break up any clumps. Place rice in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave uncovered until heated through, 2-3 minutes. While rice microwaves, in another microwave-safe bowl, combine apricot preserves, mustard (to taste), a pinch of salt, 1 Tbsp. butter, and 1 tsp. water. Microwave uncovered until butter is melted, 10-20 seconds. Carefully remove from microwave and stir to combine. To serve, top steak with sauce. Bon appétit!

Transfer chicken to towel-lined plate. Rest, at least 5 minutes. Wipe pan clean and reserve.
